issues.headline: THEY COULDN'T GET RUTH OUT
issues.dek: Day-Trippers scored 73 and allowed 55 over 16 games; final result: out in round three (17th-32nd of 128).
lead: The math was kind. The bracket was not. The line on Dock Ellis Day-Trippers reads 9-7 in the Daily Goldfather II, 73 runs for and 55 against over 16 games (4.6 scored a game, 3.4 allowed). By adjusted run difference they ranked 7th of 128. Final result: out in round three (17th-32nd of 128).
